title: Supervisor Resource History
description: Response schema for Supervisor-owned host and runtime resource history APIs.

scope.description: Top-level history scope returned by the API.

resource_id.description: Host resource id or runtime id represented by the response.

range.description: Requested history range, such as 24h or 3d.

step.description: Requested downsampling step, such as 60s. Null means raw points.

service_samples.description: Runtime child service samples. Present on runtime history responses.

container_samples.description: Runtime child container samples. Present on runtime history responses.

metrics.description: Supervisor-observed resource metrics such as CPU, memory, swap, disk, GPU, network, pid, container identity, process status, and resource source.

metadata.description: Non-secret correlation metadata such as supervisor id, host id, runtime id, parent runtime id, and resource observer.

event_type.description: Lifecycle or resource-health marker such as start_requested, restart_requested, process_unavailable, oom_indicator, or segfault_indicator.
